name: LifterLMS
summary: WordPress plugin for building and selling online courses and memberships, with a free open-source core and paid add-ons for payments, email marketing, quizzes and groups.
best_for: course creators and training businesses already on WordPress who want to own their course site and pay a yearly licence instead of a monthly platform fee
skip_if: you do not want to run WordPress yourself, or you want a hosted course platform where hosting and updates are handled for you
honest_knock: Taking payments needs a paid bundle, and every bundle renews at twice the first-year price: Earth $398, Universe $598 and Infinity $1,598 a year. LifterLMS is a WordPress plugin, so hosting, updates, backups and theme compatibility are yours to manage. Earth covers one site and one support user. We have not used LifterLMS ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Earth Bundle · per year, first year with the 50% introductory price, 1 active site
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-10 on lifterlms.com/pricing, USD) The LifterLMS core plugin for WordPress is free and open source, with unlimited courses, memberships, students and teachers. Paid bundles are annual subscriptions, shown at an introductory 50% off the first year with the code FIRSTYEAR50, and the page states that all renewals are at full price. Earth is $199 for the first year, normally $398: 1 active site, support for 1 user, the Stripe, PayPal and WooCommerce e-commerce add-ons, cart abandonment recovery and name-your-price. Universe, marked most popular, is $299 for the first year, normally $598: 5 active sites, support for 2 users, the Sky Pilot theme, 4 e-commerce add-ons, email marketing and CRM add-ons (including Mailchimp and Kit), form integrations (Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Formidable Forms, WPForms) and a weekly mastermind with a private Facebook group. Infinity is $799 for the first year, normally $1,598: unlimited sites, support for 3 users and 15 advanced add-ons such as advanced quizzes and videos, assignments, groups, private areas, a private site and social learning. A lifetime Infinity licence is offered on a separate page. A 30-day demo site with every add-on costs $1, and purchases carry a 30-day, 100% money-back guarantee with no setup fees. Licences renew automatically; you can cancel the renewal at any time.

compare_with.name: LearnWorlds
compare_with.why: LearnWorlds is in our dossiers too and is a hosted course platform with a built-in checkout and monthly pricing. LifterLMS runs inside your own WordPress site: the core is free and you pay a yearly licence for payment and advanced add-ons, but hosting and maintenance are yours.
